candidates.title: The Eagle Nebula Observed by WISE
candidates.description: The dusty face of the Eagle Nebula and its surroundings are revealed in this image based on data from NASA's Wide Field Survey Explorer (WISE). WISE detects infrared light, or a range of wavelengths longer than what the human eye can see. This large star forming region is about 5,700 light years awa

candidates.title: Eagle Nebula Flaunts its Infrared Feathers
candidates.description: This set of images from NASA Spitzer Space Telescope shows the Eagle nebula in different hues of infrared light. Each view tells a different tale.

candidates.title: Herschel Sees Through Ghostly Pillars
candidates.description: This image of the Eagle nebula shows the self-emission of the intensely cold nebula gas and dust as never seen before; the nebula intricate tendril nature, with vast cavities forms an almost cave-like surrounding to the famous pillars.

candidates.title: Cosmic Epic Unfolds in Infrared
candidates.description: This majestic view taken by NASA Spitzer Space Telescope tells an untold story of life and death in the Eagle nebula, an industrious star-making factory located 7,000 light-years away in the Serpens constellation.
